item.title: Factory Raises $200 Million at a $5 Billion Valuation
item.description: The coding-agent startup is expanding from task automation into a model-flexible software factory spanning enterprise development, testing, security and release.

item.title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live voice models
item.description: Google’s Gemini 3.8 Live models target production voice agents with faster responses, visual understanding, 97-language switching, and lower operating costs.

item.title: StepFun releases five-model StepAudio 3 family
item.description: China’s StepFun releases five StepAudio 3 models spanning realtime speech, recognition, synthesis, audio generation, and music through one platform.

item.title: TabPFN-3.5 Pushes Tabular AI Toward Production Use
item.description: Prior Labs says its new tabular foundation model leads major benchmarks while handling raw enterprise data faster and with less manual tuning.

item.title: ⚡ 15 quick hits — Morning edition, Sep 16
item.description: · Mistral announced a partnership with Mozilla to bring privacy, control, and user choice to AI-assisted browsing.（X / Mistral AI） · Alibaba Wan opened a Wan 3.0 AI-video advertising contest offering $3,000 in prizes and production credits through September 24.（X / Alibaba Wan） · Recraft announced that it has joined Tech Nation’s Future Fifty, a UK growth program for leading technology companies.（X / Recraft） · Meshy launched Ultra 4K, which it calls the first AI 3D model generation system supporting 4K geometry resolution.（X / Meshy） · Manus launched Learn AI, working with schools and training providers to help learners move from studying AI to applying it.（X / Manus） · Qualcomm, ZTE Nubia, and Doubao announced a collaboration to advance personal AI assistants on smartphones.（量子位） · Sakana AI added PowerPoint export to its research agent, preserving editable text, shapes, tables, charts, formatting, templates, and source links.（X / Sakana AI） · Prior Labs released TabPFN-3.5, which reportedly surpassed the winning Otto Kaggle solution with default settings on tabular data.（MarkTechPost） · Tsinghua University and LimiX jointly released LimiX-2, a structured-data foundation model that topped an international evaluation leaderboard.（量子位） · Bilibili launched an AI Arena where 100 leading models compete, with GPT-6 reportedly ranking first at launch.（量子位） · Google Research published a study on learned request routing for disaggregated LLM serving, reporting higher goodput than common routing baselines.（arXiv） · Researchers proposed modular defenses against prompt injection, memory poisoning, and tool manipulation in tool-integrated language-model agents.（arXiv） · Sakana AI added Interactive Reading, letting users question documents, jump to discussed passages, and open cited evidence directly.（X / Sakana AI） · Together AI made MiniMax H3 available, a 33-billion-parameter multimodal video model generating four-to-15-second clips with native stereo audio.（X / Together AI） · Luma AI introduced Camera Angles, turning one photograph into multiple consistent views of the same subject.（X / Luma AI）

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Sep 15
item.description: · AIUC raised $40 million to audit frontier models and certify AI-agent safety.（SiliconANGLE） · Perplexity detailed CobbleDB, which cut median batch-read latency from 31.4 milliseconds to 5.60 milliseconds.（X / Perplexity） · Meta now lets AI agents configure WhatsApp Business accounts, reducing setup work for merchants.（TechCrunch） · Google Research introduced Retrieve-for-Train to reduce inference bottlenecks in complex AI search systems.（Google Research） · Mem0 introduced Gateway, which gives agents scoped credentials for actions such as payments, refunds, and page archiving.（X / Mem0） · AWS published guidance on Bedrock prompt caching to reduce latency and cost for repeated model requests.（AWS） · IBM Research described ALTK-Evolve, a method for testing whether agents repeat successful behavior consistently.（Hugging Face） · Cognition added a Mac virtual machine to Devin, enabling iOS simulation, app testing, and Slack screen recordings.（X / Cognition） · Profound raised $180 million in Series D funding to improve brands’ visibility across AI services.（TechCrunch） · Krea Agent demonstrated image-to-video creation with full camera control by first building a 3D scene from an input image.（X / Krea） · Salesforce in Claude entered beta with access to customer accounts, opportunities, pipelines, and 37 sales skills.（X / Claude） · Keewano launched an agent-focused database after raising $12 million in funding.（SiliconANGLE） · Agility Robotics said Digit 5 can work beside people without safety fences by stopping and squatting when needed.（The Decoder） · Salesforce debuted Koa, a specialized model designed to reason over CRM data.（SiliconANGLE）
